story.background: Arkane Lyon is the French studio behind Dishonored and Deathloop. Microsoft owns it through Bethesda.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Marvel's Blade is one of the most anticipated Xbox titles.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The studio faces closure if no buyer is found.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Xbox has been selling or shedding studios this year.

story.happened: Microsoft extended Arkane Lyon's deadline to find a buyer from November 13 by about a month, following union pressure, PC Gamer and This Week in Videogames report. The studio has been working on Marvel's Blade.

meme.take: Arkane Lyon's deadline moved a month. In games, a delay is often the good news.

story.next: Watch for news of a buyer or a decision on the studio by mid-December.
story.summary: The consultation over Arkane Lyon, maker of Marvel's Blade, now runs to about December 13, PC Gamer reports.
story.title: Arkane Lyon's buyer deadline is pushed back a month
story.why: The studio's fate decides whether Marvel's Blade, one of Xbox's big announced games, survives.

story.background: Assassin's Creed is Ubisoft's historical action series. Tencent is a major investor in Ubisoft.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Ancient China has long been a requested setting.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Assassin's Creed is Ubisoft's biggest series.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Cancelled projects point to wider cutbacks in the industry.

story.happened: MP1st first reported the footage, which shows a female assassin in the Qin Dynasty around 206 BCE and a boss fight with Xiang Yu, VGC reports. The game was reportedly planned for console and PC before being cancelled.

meme.bottom: They got a trailer for a cancelled one
meme.take: Assassin's Creed finally visited ancient China, briefly, in someone's portfolio.
meme.top: Fans wanted Assassin's Creed in China

story.next: Watch for any comment from Ubisoft or Tencent on the project.
story.summary: Clips of Assassin's Creed Destiny, said to be made by Tencent's TiMi Studio, surfaced from developer portfolios.
story.title: Footage leaks from a reportedly cancelled Assassin's Creed set in ancient China
story.why: Fans have long asked for a mainline Assassin's Creed set in China.

story.background: Ubisoft is a French publisher. Assassin's Creed began in 2007 and Black Flag came out in 2013.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Assassin's Creed is one of gaming's best-selling series.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Black Flag is a long-time fan favourite.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Ubisoft is lowering expectations before the event.

story.happened: Ubisoft says no time or stream has been set yet, Gaming Route reports. Black Flag Resynced also gets an update on October 27 adding New Game+, a Nightmare Mode and new treasure.

meme.bottom: And said it would not announce much
meme.take: Ubisoft has an Assassin's Creed update and has already asked fans to expect little.

story.next: Watch for the time of Thursday's update and any hints about future games.
story.summary: Ubisoft's Jean Guesdon will give a series update on Thursday, but the company says there will be no major reveals.
story.title: Ubisoft sets an Assassin's Creed franchise update for October 29
story.why: Assassin's Creed is Ubisoft's biggest series, and fans watch every update for hints of what is next.

story.background: Auroch Digital is a UK studio known for Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Studio layoffs have continued across the industry this year.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows a release and comes before another.

story.happened: The cuts come shortly after Boltgun 2's release and a few weeks before Warhammer Survivors launches, This Week in Videogames reports. The studio has not given an exact headcount.

meme.bottom: Then a quarter of the team was let go
meme.take: Auroch Digital released Boltgun 2 and then announced layoffs. The industry calls this a cycle.

story.next: Watch for how the cuts affect the Warhammer Survivors launch.
story.summary: Auroch Digital announced layoffs shortly after launching Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2.
story.title: Boltgun 2 studio Auroch Digital plans to cut about a quarter of its staff
story.why: Cuts right after a launch add to concerns about job security across game studios.

story.background: Battlefield is Electronic Arts' large-scale military shooter series. Dead Space is a sci-fi horror series also owned by EA.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players have long asked for a server browser.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The Game Pass launch lines up with the start of the new season.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The Dead Space crossover revives a dormant Electronic Arts horror series.

story.happened: Season 5 launched October 13 with Vegas Strip and Area 51 maps and a Rapid Royale mode, DayOne reports. A Dead Space event runs October 20 to November 7. Battlefield 6 also joined PC Game Pass and Game Pass Ultimate the same day.

meme.take: Battlefield's new season: Vegas, aliens and Game Pass. A normal Nevada weekend.

story.next: Watch for player numbers on Game Pass and how they hold once Modern Warfare 4 arrives.
story.summary: The new season and the game's Game Pass debut both arrived on October 13, ten days before Modern Warfare 4.
story.title: Battlefield 6 Season 5 launches with Las Vegas maps and joins Game Pass
story.why: Joining Game Pass on the same day could bring a large new audience to one of the year's big shooters.

story.background: DICE made the modern Battlefront games. Respawn made the Star Wars Jedi games and Apex Legends.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Battlefront II hit its highest Steam player count in 2025.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Former developers have said they want to make another Battlefront.

story.happened: EA told staff this week, alongside significant cuts, that DICE and Respawn will join forces, Variety reports via VGC. Electronic Gaming Monthly earlier reported Lucasfilm was talking to studios about a third Battlefront.

meme.take: EA paired job cuts with a reported Battlefront revival. A new hope, with conditions.

story.next: Watch for an official announcement from EA or Lucasfilm.
story.summary: Variety reports EA told staff the two studios will work together on a future project, which sources say is Battlefront 3.
story.title: EA is said to have DICE and Respawn teaming up on Star Wars Battlefront 3
story.why: Battlefront II's player numbers surged in 2025, and fans have asked for a sequel for years.

story.background: House House is an Australian indie studio best known for Untitled Goose Game, released in 2019.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: The decision ties a game release to a political boycott.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: House House made the hit Untitled Goose Game.

story.happened: House House said Big Walk will not launch on Xbox until Microsoft or Xbox is removed as a target of the Palestinian-led BDS movement's boycott. The game was announced in June for PC, Switch 2 and PS5. The studio said it is disappointed too.

meme.bottom: Unless the friends are on Xbox
meme.take: Big Walk is about friends walking together, so long as nobody brought the wrong console.
meme.top: A game about walking with friends

story.next: Watch for any response from Microsoft and whether other studios follow.
story.summary: The Untitled Goose Game studio says its next game will not come to Xbox while Microsoft remains a BDS boycott target.
story.title: House House keeps Big Walk off Xbox, citing the BDS boycott of Microsoft
story.why: A well-known indie studio publicly skipping a major console is unusual and has stirred debate.

story.background: Bungie, owned by Sony, created Halo and Destiny. Marathon is its newer extraction shooter.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players have long asked for removed campaigns to return.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Bungie itself says "time isn't our friend."

story.happened: More on Destiny Legacy comes in early 2027, GamesRadar+ reports. Unvaulting stays in pre-production until about February 2027, with porting into 2028. Red War and Forsaken campaigns are in the first pass.

meme.bottom: It runs until 2028, give or take
meme.take: Bungie's roadmap is ambitious, carefully worded and mostly in pre-production.
meme.top: Bungie has a plan for Destiny

story.next: Watch for the Destiny Legacy details in early 2027 and Bungie's promised Marathon update.
story.summary: Bungie described plans for a Destiny "Legacy" project and old-content unvaulting, and said Marathon did not reach as many players as hoped.
story.title: Bungie lays out a Destiny roadmap and admits Marathon fell short
story.why: Destiny fans want to know the series' future after Destiny 2's updates ended.

story.background: Capcom is a Japanese game publisher. It was also hit by a ransomware attack in 2020.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 11.7 million email addresses were taken.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Capcom warns the data could be used for fake messages posing as the company.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Capcom makes Resident Evil, Street Fighter and Monster Hunter.

story.happened: Capcom detected the intrusion on October 19. Attackers took 11,774,247 email addresses plus login dates, counts and IP addresses, and extra details for 43 users. They changed passwords on 196 accounts, which Capcom has reset.

meme.bottom: It turns out that works both ways
meme.take: Capcom's single login made life easier for 11.7 million players. And for one visitor.
meme.top: Capcom ID connects all your games

story.next: Watch for phishing emails posing as Capcom, and whether any group claims the attack.
story.summary: A third party accessed Capcom ID, the company's shared login, taking email addresses and login details but not passwords or card data.
story.title: Capcom says hackers took 11.7 million account email addresses
story.why: Capcom ID links players across Resident Evil, Street Fighter and Monster Hunter, so the reach is huge.

story.background: Castlevania is Konami's series about the Belmont family's fight against Dracula, first released in 1986.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Castlevania is one of gaming's oldest action series.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have waited years for a new entry.

story.happened: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse launched October 15 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S and Switch. Developed by Evil Empire, it is set in Paris under Dracula's rule and reunites voice actors from the Netflix animated series.

meme.take: Dracula rules Paris in the new Castlevania. The locals have survived worse rent.

story.next: Watch for sales figures and whether Konami revives more of its classic series.
story.summary: Konami's new 2.5D Castlevania, set in a Paris ruled by Dracula, launched on October 15.
story.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse is out after strong reviews
story.why: It is the first new mainline-style Castlevania game in years, and reviews have been positive.

story.background: Castlevania is Konami's vampire-hunting series, first released in 1986.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Castlevania is one of gaming's oldest series.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Motion Twin made the hit Dead Cells.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $29.99 price undercuts most new releases.

story.happened: EA Sports FC 27 held No. 1, Control Resonant debuted at No. 2 and Belmont's Curse at No. 3, Nintendo Life reports from GfK data. Half of Castlevania's UK sales were on PS5 and 45% on Switch. It launched October 15 at $29.99 in the US.

meme.take: A vampire-hunting series returned after years in its coffin, and finished behind FIFA.
meme.top: Castlevania came back after years away

story.next: Watch for whether it holds in the charts as bigger holiday games arrive.
story.summary: Konami's new Castlevania entered at No. 3 behind EA Sports FC 27 and newcomer Control Resonant.
story.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse debuts third in the UK charts
story.why: It is the first new Castlevania in years, and an early chart showing tests whether fans came back.

story.background: Circana tracks US video game sales. Its monthly report is the main public measure of US console sales.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Sony gained while Nintendo and Xbox fell.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Average console prices rose sharply from a year ago.

story.happened: US hardware unit sales fell 3% in September, Circana data shows. PS5 rose 22%, Switch 2 fell 14% and Xbox Series fell 27%, a new September low. Marvel's Wolverine was the month's best-selling game, VGC reports.

meme.take: Xbox raised prices and sold fewer consoles. Economists can finally stop arguing about this.

story.next: Watch for October's figures, which will include Modern Warfare 4's launch.
story.summary: Circana's September figures show PS5 up 22%, Switch 2 down 14% and Xbox Series down 27% from a year ago.
story.title: PS5 sales rise while Xbox hits a September low in the US
story.why: Console sales show which platforms are winning as prices rise across the board.

story.background: Remedy Entertainment is the Finnish studio behind Max Payne, Alan Wake and Control.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The first Control has sold over five million copies.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It hit the milestone ahead of a crowded autumn release slate.

story.happened: Remedy said Control Resonant passed one million copies sold in three weeks, making it the studio's fastest seller. The game released in late September.

meme.bottom: Now very clear about its sales
meme.take: Control Resonant sold a million copies, a rare paranormal event Remedy was happy to report.
meme.top: A game about a mysterious bureau

story.next: Watch for Remedy's next earnings update and any expansion plans.
story.summary: Remedy says the Control sequel is its fastest-selling game.
story.title: Remedy's Control Resonant sells one million copies in three weeks
story.why: Strong sales matter for a mid-sized studio betting on its own franchises.

story.background: CD Projekt Red is the Polish studio behind The Witcher games and Cyberpunk 2077.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrived two days after Edgerunners 2 launched on Netflix.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Console players have long asked for mod support.

story.happened: Version 2.5, called the Edgerunners 2 update, went live on October 22 with content tied to the new Netflix anime, Pure Xbox reports. It adds cross-platform mod support, and Cyberpunk 2077 now supports Xbox Play Anywhere.

meme.bottom: Two years ago, and again now
meme.take: CD Projekt said Cyberpunk was finished two years ago. Night City had other plans.

story.next: Watch for which mods reach consoles first and whether player counts rise.
story.summary: CD Projekt's Edgerunners 2 update arrived October 22 and adds cross-platform mod support on consoles.
story.title: Cyberpunk 2077 update 2.5 is out, with Edgerunners 2 content and mods
story.why: It is another big update for a game CD Projekt once said was finished.

story.background: Dead by Daylight is an asymmetric horror game in which one killer hunts four survivors.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Other licensed killers have left the game before.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players are buying the chapter before it goes.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Chucky has been a horror icon since 1988.

story.happened: The Chucky Chapter leaves stores on November 24, and players who own Chucky, his perks or cosmetics keep them, Gaming Route reports. Behaviour told IGN its goal is always to keep licences forever.

meme.take: Chucky leaves Dead by Daylight in November. Licensing is the scariest thing in horror.
meme.top: Chucky is leaving Dead by Daylight

story.next: Watch for which other licensed killers could follow.
story.summary: Behaviour Interactive says the Chucky content leaves stores next month, though owners will keep it.
story.title: Dead by Daylight will remove its Chucky chapter on November 24
story.why: Licensed horror icons leaving the game has become a pattern, and fans worry about who is next.

story.background: Deadlock is Valve's hero shooter mixed with a battle arena game, tested publicly by invitation.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Over 300,000 at once ranks it among Steam's biggest games.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players are still asking friends for invites.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Valve rarely releases new multiplayer games.

story.happened: Deadlock peaked at 303,347 concurrent players, per SteamDB, Destructoid reports. New hero Violet arrived on October 16, and another hero, Nurse Harrow, is due on October 20.

meme.take: Deadlock is invite-only and has 303,000 players, which stretches the word exclusive.
meme.top: A game you need an invite for

story.next: Watch for whether Nurse Harrow's arrival on October 20 pushes the record higher.
story.summary: Deadlock hit a peak of 303,347 concurrent players, making it Steam's fourth most-played game while still invite-only.
story.title: Valve's invite-only Deadlock passes 300,000 players on Steam
story.why: A game this popular without even being openly available is rare, and it hints at a big Valve launch ahead.

story.background: Diablo 4 is Blizzard's action role-playing game, released in 2023.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players test builds early to plan the new season.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Seasonal updates keep live games in the conversation.

story.happened: The PTR adds War Plans Tactics, Tyrael's Boons and Horadric Items, plus major class changes, Gaming Route reports. It is open on PC only until November 3.

meme.bottom: Every build is guilty until tested
meme.take: Diablo 4's Season 16 test has begun. Theorycrafters have cancelled their week.

story.next: Watch for balance changes before the season goes live.
story.summary: Blizzard's 3.3.0 public test realm for Diablo 4 runs on PC from October 27 to November 3.
story.title: Diablo 4's Season 16 test realm opens with big class changes
story.why: Test realms show players which builds will rise or fall before a new season starts.

story.background: The Duskbloods is a multiplayer action game being made only for Nintendo's Switch 2.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: FromSoftware made Elden Ring and Dark Souls.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: It is a high-profile Switch 2 exclusive.

story.happened: FromSoftware said the game is at its final adjustment stage and the test showed interest in its combat and strategy. It will use the time on game rules and balancing, GamesRadar+ reports. No new date was given.

meme.bottom: So is releasing them on time
meme.take: The Duskbloods needs more balancing, and so do the schedules of Switch 2 owners.

story.next: Watch for a firm 2027 release date from FromSoftware or Nintendo.
story.summary: FromSoftware moved The Duskbloods from 2026 to 2027, saying it needs time for final adjustments after its August network test.
story.title: FromSoftware delays Switch 2 exclusive The Duskbloods to 2027
story.why: It was one of the Switch 2's biggest exclusives for this year, from the studio behind Elden Ring.

story.background: BioWare was founded in 1995 in Edmonton and bought by EA in 2007. Its last game was Dragon Age: The Veilguard in 2024.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: BioWare made Baldur's Gate, Knights of the Old Republic and Mass Effect.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The buyout added about $18 billion in debt, and EA has promised big savings.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 400 jobs are going across EA, Bloomberg reports.

story.happened: BioWare said early work on the next Mass Effect is ending, and Bloomberg reports about 400 EA jobs are going. A Canadian party leader has since called for federal support so staff could take over the studio, This Week in Videogames reports.

meme.take: BioWare is closing after 30 years. A sad ending, and not one players got to pick.

story.next: Watch for what EA does with the Mass Effect and Dragon Age names and news on the TV series.
story.summary: The studio behind Mass Effect and Dragon Age is shutting as EA cuts about 400 jobs after its $55 billion buyout.
story.title: EA is closing BioWare and cancelling the next Mass Effect
story.why: BioWare made some of the most loved role-playing games of the last 30 years.

story.background: Bethesda, owned by Microsoft, makes The Elder Scrolls. Skyrim, the last main game, came out in 2011.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have waited for news since a 2018 teaser.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The reveal is reportedly tied to Skyrim's 15th anniversary.

story.happened: The Verge cites unnamed sources and expects only a title reveal, not gameplay or a date. The reveal is said to be tied to Skyrim's 15th anniversary, possibly November 11. Bethesda has not confirmed it.

meme.bottom: The game itself remains a rumor
meme.take: Eight years after the teaser, fans are thrilled to learn what to call the wait.
meme.top: Elder Scrolls VI may finally get a name

story.next: Watch for an official reveal from Bethesda around Skyrim's anniversary.
story.summary: The Verge reports the next Elder Scrolls game is titled Sentinel and set in Hammerfell, with a title reveal possibly next month.
story.title: The Elder Scrolls VI is reported to be called Sentinel, with a reveal in November
story.why: It has been one of gaming's longest waits since Bethesda announced the game in 2018.

story.background: Epic Games makes Fortnite and the Unreal Engine. Disney owns Marvel and Lucasfilm.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The game involves Marvel and Star Wars characters.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Bloomberg says many staff reacted with shock.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Disney invested $1.5 billion in Epic in 2024.

story.happened: Epic told staff on an unannounced shooter with Marvel and Star Wars characters to go AI-first, including generating art with AI, Bloomberg reports. The game is reportedly behind schedule. Epic said its approach is AI-accelerated development led by its own developers.

meme.bottom: New plan: AI does the art
meme.take: Epic says humans still lead the work. The AI, reportedly, handles the drawing part.

story.next: Watch for staff reaction, any new release date and whether Epic applies the policy to other teams.
story.summary: Bloomberg says developers were told to stop hand-writing code and artists to use AI, using Anthropic's Claude.
story.title: Epic reportedly orders an 'AI-first' workflow on its delayed Disney shooter
story.why: It is one of the most direct moves yet by a major studio to replace parts of game development with AI.

story.background: Epic Games makes Fortnite and the Unreal Engine. Disney announced a $1.5 billion investment in Epic in 2024.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Many developers and players oppose AI-generated game art.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It involves Epic, Marvel and Star Wars.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Studios are testing how far AI can replace hand-built work.

story.happened: Epic's unannounced shooter featuring Marvel and Star Wars characters slipped from March to an unspecified date, Bloomberg reports. A director's email said there would be no more hand-written code. Epic said its developers remain the creative drivers. Bloomberg says Epic uses tools like Anthropic's Claude.

meme.bottom: The delay was written by hand
meme.take: Epic went AI-first and the first thing it produced was a delay.

story.next: Watch for an official reveal and how players react to AI-made art.
story.summary: Bloomberg reports an internal email told staff 'no more hand-written code' and that art would come from AI workflows.
story.title: Epic delays its Marvel and Star Wars shooter as it goes AI-first
story.why: It is one of the boldest moves yet by a major game studio to build with AI.

story.background: Epic Games makes Fortnite and the Unreal Engine and runs the Epic Games Store.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Epic's CEO announced a company-wide shift to AI-accelerated development.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Epic compared the launcher directly with Valve's Steam.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Epic laid off about 1,000 staff in March.

story.happened: Epic says the new launcher cold-starts to the store in about 5.5 seconds, versus just over 10 for Steam, and is in testing on Windows, Mac and, for the first time, Linux. Its post explained the use of AI tools by saying programming is hard.

meme.bottom: It now loads in five and a half seconds
meme.take: Epic's launcher finally got faster. It only took removing the people.
meme.top: Epic let AI write its launcher

story.next: Watch for player tests of the speed claims and when the new launcher rolls out widely.
story.summary: Epic's rebuilt Epic Games Launcher is in testing and, the company claims, boots faster than Steam.
story.title: Epic tests a new launcher it says was built entirely with AI
story.why: It is a high-profile test of AI-written software, from a company that has openly pivoted to AI development.

story.background: EA Sports makes EA Sports FC, Madden NFL and other sports games.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Fight Night Champion was the last new entry, in 2011.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It was announced a day before EA said it would close BioWare.

story.happened: EA Sports confirmed a new Fight Night through a new social account, VGC reports. It will be the first entry in about 15 years; the last, Fight Night Champion, came out in 2011 on Xbox 360 and PS3.

meme.take: Fight Night returns after 15 years, a long count even by boxing's standards.
meme.top: Fight Night is back after 15 years

story.next: Watch for a reveal trailer, platforms and a release window.
story.summary: EA Sports announced the return of its boxing series through a new social media account.
story.title: EA confirms Fight Night is coming back after 15 years
story.why: Fight Night was one of EA's best-loved sports series, and fans have asked for its return for years.

story.background: Final Fantasy is Square Enix's role-playing series, running since 1987.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Its pixel-art HD-2D look recalls the series' 1990s games.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Turn-based Final Fantasy games have become rare.

story.happened: Square Enix's turn-based HD-2D game launched on October 22, including on Xbox. Pure Xbox reported very strong early reviews, mostly of the PS5 and Switch 2 versions, and Famitsu's four critics each gave it 9 out of 10.

meme.bottom: Final Fantasy fans call that a warm-up
meme.take: Final Fantasy Resonance takes 70 hours to finish. Series fans call that a long weekend.

story.next: Watch for early sales figures and how it ranks on Japan's weekly charts.
story.summary: Square Enix's HD-2D game launched October 22 on consoles including Xbox, PS5 and Switch 2.
story.title: Final Fantasy Resonance is out now after strong early reviews
story.why: It is a classic-style Final Fantasy, the kind many long-time fans have asked for.

story.background: Final Fantasy is Square Enix's role-playing game series, first released in 1987.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Final Fantasy is one of gaming's oldest major series.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It launches a day before Modern Warfare 4.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It costs $49.99, less than many big releases.

story.happened: Famitsu's four reviewers each gave Final Fantasy Resonance 9 out of 10, Pure Xbox reports. Famitsu puts the main story at about 20 to 30 hours and full completion near 70. It launches October 22 at $49.99 on Xbox and PC, with other platforms listed.

meme.take: Final Fantasy Resonance runs about 70 hours, which counts as a weekend in this series.

story.next: Watch for Western reviews and launch-week sales.
story.summary: Famitsu's reviewers scored Square Enix's new RPG highly ahead of its October 22 release.
story.title: Final Fantasy Resonance gets 36 out of 40 in its first review
story.why: A strong first score raises hopes for a major RPG launching in a crowded month.

story.background: HD-2D is Square Enix's style that mixes pixel-art characters with 3D scenery, first used in Octopath Traveler.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Final Fantasy is one of the biggest names in role-playing games.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Square Enix's HD-2D games have built a steady following.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Launch-week player counts are tracked closely on SteamDB.

story.happened: Resonance narrowly passed Dragon Quest 7 Reimagined's 27,390 peak, GamesRadar reports, citing SteamDB. Dragon Quest 3 HD-2D Remake still holds the record at 45,357. The game adapts the mobile title Final Fantasy Brave Exvius.

meme.bottom: In the style of an older game
meme.take: Final Fantasy Resonance turns a mobile game into pixel art. Progress, but sideways.
meme.top: Square Enix remade a mobile game

story.next: Watch for the first-weekend peak, which often tops day-one numbers on Steam.
story.summary: The HD-2D spinoff peaked at 27,933 players on its first day, Square Enix's second-best Steam start for a turn-based RPG.
story.title: Final Fantasy Resonance has a strong start on Steam
story.why: It suggests the HD-2D style remains a reliable hit for Square Enix with PC players.

story.background: Fire Emblem is Nintendo's tactical role-playing series, first released in 1990.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fire Emblem fans tend to play for many hours.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Expansion passes add revenue after launch.

story.happened: Nintendo announced an expansion pass for Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, which launched last month, Simulation Daily reports. Wave 1, with four weapons, is out now. Wave 2 adds outfits and three allies this holiday, and Wave 3 brings new stories in 2027.

meme.take: Fire Emblem's expansion arrives in waves, which is how strategy fans like problems.

story.next: Watch for the release date of Wave 2.
story.summary: Nintendo's pass adds weapons now, new allies this holiday season and new stories in 2027.
story.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave gets a three-wave expansion pass
story.why: Paid expansions keep a strategy game alive long after launch.

story.background: Apple pulled Fortnite from its App Store in 2020 after Epic added its own payment system.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Epic and Apple have fought over app store rules for years.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Fortnite is one of the most played games in the world.

story.happened: The Federal Court ordered Apple to ease restrictions on iOS, opening a path for Fortnite's return on October 22, PYMNTS reports. Apple rejects key parts of the ruling and will seek to suspend it during its appeal.

meme.take: Fortnite is back on Australian iPhones. Apple's appeal is also a long-running live service.

story.next: Watch for Apple's appeal and whether the ruling is paused in the meantime.
story.summary: Epic's game returned to Australian iPhones after the Federal Court found Apple breached competition law. Apple plans to appeal.
story.title: Fortnite is back on Apple's App Store in Australia after a court ruling
story.why: It is another crack in Apple's control over how apps reach iPhones, after similar fights in the US and Europe.

story.background: Funcom is a Norwegian game studio known for Conan Exiles and Dune: Awakening.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Job cuts continue across the games industry.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Dune is a major science fiction franchise.

story.happened: Dune: Awakening launched on Xbox Series and PS5 on September 22, Instant Gaming reports. Funcom says it is restructuring because the game now runs as a live service, and part of its staff is being let go.

meme.take: The spice must flow, and in this case so must the restructuring.

story.next: Watch for how many roles are cut and Funcom's update plans for Dune: Awakening.
story.summary: The studio is restructuring as the survival game shifts to a games-as-a-service model, a month after reaching PS5 and Xbox.
story.title: Funcom lays off staff after Dune: Awakening's console launch
story.why: Layoffs after a big launch show how tough the games business remains.

story.background: Ghost of Yotei is Sucker Punch's follow-up to 2020's Ghost of Tsushima, published by Sony.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Over $400 million in estimated revenue is a big result.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is being compared with Ghost of Tsushima.

story.happened: Alinea estimates Ghost of Yotei has sold about 5.4 million copies on PS5, worth $407 million, Gaming Route reports. That puts it roughly 1.5 million units behind Ghost of Tsushima at the same point.

meme.take: Ghost of Yotei earned an estimated $407 million and still hears about Tsushima at dinner.

story.next: Watch for Sony's own figures in its next earnings report.
story.summary: Analytics firm Alinea estimates Sony's samurai sequel has sold 5.4 million copies and earned $407 million.
story.title: Ghost of Yotei estimated at 5.4 million copies on PS5
story.why: It is Sony's flagship single-player release, and sales are watched as a sign of the PS5's strength.

story.background: Rockstar Games is owned by Take-Two. GTA 6 is set in Leonida, a fictional version of Florida.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: GTA 5 is one of the best-selling games of all time.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The game launches in November on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

story.happened: The Miami Heat will rebrand as Vice City for a themed night, and Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell have appeared at the Kaseya Center, VGC reports. Cars with Vice City plates, beach umbrellas and in-game brand ads have also been spotted.

meme.take: Rockstar is rebranding Miami as Vice City. The changeover has reportedly been very smooth.

story.next: Watch for more real-world stunts as the November launch gets closer.
story.summary: Fictional GTA brands have appeared across Miami, from Burger Shot stands to Vice City buses and a Miami Heat theme night.
story.title: Rockstar turns real Miami into GTA 6's Vice City ahead of launch
story.why: GTA 6 is the most anticipated game in years, and its marketing is now spilling into a real city.

story.background: Grand Theft Auto VI is Rockstar's first new main GTA game since GTA V in 2013.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: 29% of US players say they plan to buy it, a Circana record.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Grand Theft Auto is one of the best-selling game series ever.

story.happened: Justice composed the score. Circana analyst Mat Piscatella reported the 29% figure among US console and PC players. A new gameplay clip with Jason and Lucia also aired in a South Park episode.

meme.bottom: Marketing has no subtle mode left
meme.take: GTA VI got an album date, a cartoon cameo and a record poll, a normal week for it.
meme.top: GTA VI showed up on South Park

story.next: Watch for more Rockstar marketing and the December 11 album release.
story.summary: Rockstar set the GTA VI soundtrack album for December 11, and Circana measured 29% US purchase intent, its highest for any game.
story.title: GTA VI gets a December soundtrack date and record purchase intent
story.why: GTA VI is the most anticipated game in years, and every new detail draws huge attention.

story.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' open-world crime series. Rockstar is owned by Take-Two.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: GTA V is one of the best-selling games of all time.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have waited over a decade for a new main entry.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The game is just over a month from launch.

story.happened: Rockstar released the launch trailer on October 15, set to music by Justice, VGC reports. Digital Foundry's Richard Leadbetter said he doubts the PS5-captured footage uses the QSSR upscaler. The game launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

meme.bottom: Analysed one frame at a time
meme.take: GTA VI's trailer has now been studied more closely than most school textbooks.
meme.top: Ninety seconds of GTA VI footage

story.next: Watch for preload details and early reviews before November 19.
story.summary: Rockstar's 90-second launch trailer is still being analysed, with Digital Foundry doubting it uses the PS5's new upscaler.
story.title: GTA VI's launch trailer gets picked apart a month before release
story.why: GTA VI is one of the most anticipated games ever, and this is the last look before release.

story.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' open-world crime series. Take-Two Interactive is Rockstar's parent company.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: GTA 6 is one of the most anticipated games ever.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The threat comes about a month before release.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: The group ties its leaks to a crypto promotion and to the digital-only plan.

story.happened: The leaker said it would post a full 200GB+ build if its meme coin hit a $30 million market cap, Kotaku reports. The coin passed $4.75 million over the weekend, then fell 50% in 24 hours to about $2.2 million. No playable build has been verified.

meme.bottom: The coin did what coins do
meme.take: Threatening Rockstar via crypto: two volatile assets, one terrible plan.
meme.top: Leak plan: tied to a meme coin

story.next: Watch for legal action by Take-Two and fake 'build' downloads carrying malware.

stats.label: market cap demanded for full leak

story.summary: Cyberleek promised escalating clips as its coin's value rose, then the coin lost half its value in a day.
story.title: GTA 6 leaker's meme coin crashes as it threatens to post the full game
story.why: GTA 6 is the most anticipated game in years, and leaks this close to launch spread to millions within hours.

story.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' open-world crime series, owned by Take-Two Interactive.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: GTA V is one of the best-selling games of all time.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players have waited more than a decade for a new GTA.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It launches into the busy holiday season.

story.happened: GTA VI was first planned for 2025, then May 2026, and now November 19. GamesMarket reports retailers are building campaigns around it, from Best Buy's Gamers Beta to German grocer Edeka listing the game. GamesBeat has reported a PC version for early 2027, unconfirmed by Rockstar.

meme.bottom: Even the grocery store is ready
meme.take: GTA VI is now listed at a German supermarket. Fans had assumed it was still a rumour.
meme.top: GTA VI is one month away

story.next: Watch for preload details and any word on the reported PC version.
story.summary: With a month to go, retailers from Best Buy in the US to Germany's Edeka are lining up GTA VI campaigns.
story.title: GTA VI is now one month from its November 19 release
story.why: GTA VI is expected to be one of the biggest entertainment launches ever.

story.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' open-world crime series. Rockstar's past GTA games reached PC after consoles.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: GTA 6 is one of the most anticipated games ever.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: PC players were left out of the launch plan.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It comes just over a month before release.

story.happened: Rockstar plans to release GTA 6 on PC in the first quarter of 2027, GamesBeat reports, citing four people familiar with the plans, via Beebom. The game launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19. Rockstar has not confirmed a PC date.

meme.take: Reported PC date: early 2027. PC players: already arguing about graphics settings.

story.next: Watch for any update at Take-Two's earnings on November 9.
story.summary: GamesBeat says Rockstar plans a PC release a few months after the November 19 console launch.
story.title: GTA 6 on PC is reported for the first three months of 2027
story.why: PC players have been waiting to hear when they can play the biggest game of the year.

story.background: Valve makes Half-Life and runs Steam. Its last Half-Life game was the VR title Half-Life: Alyx in 2020.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have waited for a numbered sequel since Half-Life 2: Episode Two in 2007.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Half-Life is one of the most influential series in PC gaming.

story.happened: Talking about audio, Morasky said Deadlock and HLX each have their own version of an HDR system, VGC reports. HLX has turned up in the code of Deadlock and Dota 2. Valve has not confirmed a new Half-Life.

meme.take: One Valve developer said 'HLX' at a conference. Fans have already booked time off work.
meme.top: A Valve developer said three letters

story.next: Watch for any official word from Valve, which rarely comments on unannounced games.
story.summary: Valve's Mike Morasky mentioned HLX, the rumoured codename for a new Half-Life, during a GameSoundCon talk.
story.title: A Valve developer says 'HLX' on stage, fuelling Half-Life 3 talk
story.why: Half-Life 3 is one of the longest-awaited sequels in gaming.

story.background: Helldivers 2 is a co-op shooter by Arrowhead Game Studios, published by Sony.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Negative Steam reviews outnumbered positive ones about six to one on the day.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Helldivers 2 has a large modding community on PC.

story.happened: The switch arrived on October 20 with balance changes and fixes. Mods that affect other players may stop working. PC Gamer counted 846 negative and 146 positive Steam reviews that day, Gameluster reports.

meme.take: Helldivers 2 fights bugs for managed democracy. This week they were in the mod folder.

story.next: Watch for whether Arrowhead tweaks the rules for cosmetic mods.

stats.label: negative Steam reviews on day one

story.summary: Arrowhead replaced GameGuard with Epic's Easy Anti-Cheat in update 7.2.0, citing a rise in cheat mods.
story.title: Helldivers 2 swaps to Easy Anti-Cheat and some mods break
story.why: Anti-cheat changes often break fan-made mods, and players are quick to review-bomb when they do.

story.background: Helldivers 2 is a co-op shooter from Swedish studio Arrowhead, published by Sony in 2024.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Helldivers 2 still has a large, active community.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It is one of PlayStation's most successful online games.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The comment came during an anniversary-style event.

story.happened: Pilestedt told Rock Paper Shotgun that Helldivers 3 isn't in development, Gaming Route reports. The Liberty Day event gave players free items, including the AR-23L Liberator Legacy rifle.

meme.take: Helldivers 3 is not in development. The war for Super Earth will continue in the same game.

story.next: Watch for Arrowhead's next major Helldivers 2 update.
story.summary: During Helldivers 2's Liberty Day event, Arrowhead's Johan Pilestedt said a third game is not being made.
story.title: Arrowhead says Helldivers 3 is not in development
story.why: Helldivers 2 is one of Sony's biggest live-service hits, so fans want to know how long it will be supported.

story.background: ID@Xbox is Microsoft's programme for publishing independent games on Xbox and PC.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Mouthwashing was a cult horror hit on PC.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Shrek 2 and The Wolf Among Us are returning remasters.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 20 games were shown.

story.happened: A Game About Digging A Hole Together launches December 4 on Game Pass, Xbox Wire says. Mouthwashing and The Wolf Among Us Remastered arrive October 29, and Shrek 2 Remastered on November 10. Croak is set for March 2027.

meme.bottom: One of them is just digging a hole
meme.take: The ID@Xbox showcase delivered horror, Shrek and a co-op hole. Something for every mood.
meme.top: Xbox showed dozens of indie games

story.next: Watch for which of the showcased games climb Steam and Game Pass charts.
story.summary: Microsoft's indie showcase with IGN set dates for more than a dozen games, from Shrek 2 Remastered to Croak.
story.title: ID@Xbox showcase reveals A Game About Digging A Hole Together and Mouthwashing date
story.why: Indie showcases are where many of the year's surprise hits first get noticed.

story.background: It Takes Two is a two-player co-op adventure from Hazelight Studios, published by Electronic Arts in 2021.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Co-op fans have asked for wider cross-play.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands in a busy week of Switch 2 releases.

story.happened: It Takes Two arrives on Switch 2 on October 15 as a free upgrade for Switch 1 owners, Nintendo Life reports. It runs at 1080p and 60fps docked and supports cross-play with PC, Xbox and PlayStation. The Friend's Pass stays.

meme.take: It Takes Two arrives on Switch 2, still refusing to be anyone's solo hobby.
meme.top: A game you can't play alone

story.next: Watch for how the Switch 2 version performs in handheld mode.
story.summary: EA's co-op hit gets a free upgrade for Switch owners, with 1080p and 60fps when docked.
story.title: It Takes Two comes to Switch 2 on October 15 with cross-play
story.why: It Takes Two is one of the most popular co-op games, and cross-play lets friends on other consoles join.

story.background: Konami is a Japanese publisher that has returned to big-budget games in recent years.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: AI in game development divides players and developers.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Konami owns Metal Gear, Silent Hill and Castlevania.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Other industry leaders have backed AI for routine work this week.

story.happened: In Konami's new business report, Hayakawa said teams create new ideas through a hard-to-replace 'chemical reaction', VGC reports. He said Konami still helps creators learn new tools and use them safely.

meme.bottom: Konami's lab coats remain in place
meme.take: Konami's president trusts people over AI, which is good news for people at Konami.
meme.top: Konami says AI cannot replace chemistry

story.next: Watch for how Konami's Metal Gear, Silent Hill and Castlevania projects use new tools.
story.summary: Hideki Hayakawa says generative AI will not change the games market much and that creators matter most.
story.title: Konami's president says AI cannot replace the people behind great games
story.why: Game studios are split on AI, and a major publisher taking a clear stance draws attention.

story.background: Konami is a Japanese publisher behind Metal Gear, Silent Hill and eFootball.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Profit rose 75.1% in six months.

drivers.label: Revived franchises
drivers.text: Konami has been reviving series such as Silent Hill.

story.happened: The results cover the six months from April to September 2026, Instant Gaming reports, with the gains credited to its recent releases.

meme.take: Konami's profit jumped 75%, a strong argument for releasing the games people asked for.

story.next: Watch for Konami's next release plans and full-year forecast.
story.summary: Konami reported a 75.1% profit increase and 44.3% sales growth for April to September 2026.
story.title: Konami's profit rises 75% on the back of its recent games
story.why: It shows Konami's return to big console releases is paying off.

story.background: Liquid Swords was founded in 2020 by Christofer Sundberg, co-founder of Avalanche Studios.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Even studios that ship a game are struggling to stay afloat.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Studio closures have been frequent through 2026.

story.happened: Breakit reports Liquid Swords was declared bankrupt after failing to pay salaries for several months. The state will compensate about 30 staff, and the studio hopes to find a buyer. Samson launched in April 2026 to mixed reviews.

meme.bottom: Then it ran out of money to pay for it
meme.take: Releasing a game used to be the hard part. Now it is staying open afterwards.
meme.top: Liquid Swords shipped its first game

story.next: Watch for whether a buyer takes on the studio or Samson.
story.summary: The Swedish studio founded by a former Just Cause director is bankrupt after months of unpaid wages, with about 30 jobs affected.
story.title: Liquid Swords, the studio behind Samson, goes bankrupt
story.why: It adds to a long run of studio closures and job losses across the games industry.

story.background: LittleBigPlanet is Sony's creative platform game series, first released on PS3 in 2008.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI coding tools are being used for ever larger hobby projects.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Unofficial ports raise copyright questions.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: LittleBigPlanet was a PS3-era favourite.

story.happened: A native PC port of LittleBigPlanet has appeared, and the project says it used Claude Opus 5.5, Instant Gaming reports. The site says Astro Bot and God of War III Remastered have also been made playable on PC through AI-based efforts.

meme.take: LittleBigPlanet reached PC without Sony's help, which is one way to skip a meeting.

story.next: Watch for whether Sony responds to the unofficial ports.
story.summary: The PS3 game joins Astro Bot and God of War III as PlayStation titles brought to PC through AI-assisted efforts, per Instant Gaming.
story.title: LittleBigPlanet gets a fan-made PC port reportedly built with an AI model
story.why: If AI can port old console games, it raises hard questions about preservation and ownership.

story.background: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is a tag-team fighting game made by Arc System Works and published by PlayStation.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Roster reveals are big moments for fighting game players.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The game uses Marvel's comic book heroes.

story.happened: Jane Foster, Venom and Jubilee will join Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls as Year 1 downloadable content, Game Informer reports. Phoenix Cyclops arrives first, in November.

meme.take: Marvel Tokon adds three fighters, because no Marvel roster has ever been finished.

story.next: Watch for release dates and gameplay reveals for the new fighters.
story.summary: Three more fighters are coming to Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls after launch, alongside Phoenix Cyclops in November.
story.title: Marvel Tokon adds Jane Foster, Venom and Jubilee as Year 1 DLC
story.why: Fighting game fans follow roster news closely, and Marvel characters draw a wide audience.

story.background: Mass Effect is BioWare's science fiction role-playing series, which began in 2007.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans had waited years for the next Mass Effect after a 2020 teaser.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It leaked just days after the game was cancelled.

story.happened: A trailer for what would have been the fifth Mass Effect game was posted to the series' Reddit community, Simulation Daily reports. It surfaced after EA announced BioWare's closure and the end of work on the game.

meme.take: Mass Effect finally showed its next game, in the most BioWare way possible: too late.
meme.top: The next Mass Effect got a trailer

story.next: Watch for whether EA comments on the footage or says anything about the series' future.
story.summary: Footage said to be from the fifth Mass Effect game appeared on Reddit days after EA said it was closing BioWare.
story.title: A trailer for the cancelled next Mass Effect leaks online
story.why: Fans are getting their first look at a game that will now never be released.

story.background: Shigeru Miyamoto joined Nintendo in 1977 and created many of its biggest series.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Miyamoto created Mario, Donkey Kong and The Legend of Zelda.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Generative AI in games remains a heated topic among players and developers.

story.happened: Miyamoto argues that AI could raise the value of creators rather than replace them, VGC reports. The same week, Creative Assembly publicly rejected AI art in a Total War: Shogun 2 re-release.

meme.bottom: His plumber has never retired either
meme.take: Mario's creator says humans still matter in games. The plumber has held one job since 1981.
meme.top: Miyamoto says AI won't replace creators

story.next: Watch for how Nintendo and other studios set rules for AI in game development.
story.summary: Nintendo's best-known designer argues AI could make human creators more important, not less.
story.title: Shigeru Miyamoto says AI will not make human creativity obsolete
story.why: Game studios are split over generative AI, so a view from Mario's creator carries weight.

story.background: Call of Duty is Activision's military shooter series. Activision is owned by Microsoft.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Call of Duty is one of gaming's biggest yearly releases.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Battlefield 6 joined Game Pass ten days before its launch.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is coming to Nintendo Switch 2.

story.happened: Modern Warfare 4's campaign opens early on October 16 for digital pre-orders, with DMZ early access on October 20, GamingBible reports. The full game launches October 23. PC needs 115GB of free SSD space, and the game is not on Game Pass at launch.

meme.take: Modern Warfare 4 lands on Switch 2, so the war is now portable. Bring a charger.

story.next: Watch for campaign impressions this weekend and launch player numbers on October 23.
story.summary: Digital pre-order buyers can play the campaign a week before the October 23 launch on PS5, Xbox, PC and Switch 2.
story.title: Modern Warfare 4's campaign early access starts today
story.why: Call of Duty is one of the best-selling series every year, and this is its first entry on Switch 2.

story.background: Call of Duty is Activision's shooter series, now owned by Microsoft. Infinity Ward made this game.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Call of Duty is usually among the year's best-selling games.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The franchise has passed $40 billion in lifetime revenue.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Microsoft reports quarterly results on October 28.

story.happened: Kotaku notes MW4 has the best Call of Duty Metacritic score in 15 years, but Steam player counts trail Black Ops 6. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said the series has passed $40 billion in lifetime revenue.

meme.bottom: The silence is doing the talking
meme.take: Activision shared a franchise total instead of MW4 sales. Numbers are shy this year.

story.next: Watch for Microsoft's earnings call on October 28 for sales details.
story.summary: Modern Warfare 4 has strong reviews, but Activision has not shared sales figures or claimed launch records.
story.title: Activision stays quiet on Modern Warfare 4 sales after launch weekend
story.why: Call of Duty's launch performance is closely watched as a gauge of the whole games market.

story.background: Call of Duty is published by Activision, which Microsoft owns.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Shoot House returns from earlier Modern Warfare games.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Call of Duty is one of the best-selling series every year.

story.happened: Activision gave more detail on Season 1 content, including three multiplayer maps, Instant Gaming reports. Shoot House is a returning fan-favourite map from earlier Modern Warfare games.

meme.bottom: One of them is the old one
meme.take: Modern Warfare 4's newest content includes Shoot House, back by popular demand and habit.

story.next: Watch for the full Season 1 roadmap and launch-day player numbers.
story.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's first season launches November 6 with the MJ Backstab, Canyon and Shoot House maps.
story.title: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 arrives November 6 with Shoot House
story.why: A first season sets the pace for a Call of Duty game's year of live updates.

story.background: Xbox is Microsoft's gaming division. Microsoft said in March that Helix will run both Xbox and PC games.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The reported price range is far above any current console.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Microsoft is trying to revive Xbox against PlayStation and Nintendo.

story.happened: Fortune's profile of Xbox chief Asha Sharma reports Project Helix is due by holiday 2028, with internal price projections of $1,200 to $1,800. It also reports a next-generation handheld by holiday 2027 and plans to sell Game Pass features a la carte.

meme.bottom: It also runs PC games, to be fair
meme.take: Microsoft's next console may cost as much as a gaming PC, which it also more or less is.

story.next: Watch for any official word on pricing or Game Pass changes; none of this is confirmed.
story.summary: Fortune reports internal projections put Project Helix far above today's console prices unless Microsoft subsidises it.
story.title: Next Xbox reportedly due in 2028 at $1,200 to $1,800, with a handheld in 2027
story.why: A console above $1,000 would be a big shift for a market built on cheaper hardware.

story.background: Indie World is Nintendo's recurring video showcase for independent games on its consoles.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Witchbrook topped Nintendo Life's most-anticipated poll with 14%.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Many of the games are aimed at a busy early 2027.

story.happened: Sword of the Sea arrived on Switch 2 on October 29 and Spirit Crossing follows on November 16, Gaming Trend reports. Free demos went live for games including Petal Runner and newly revealed Winds of Viridia.

meme.take: Nintendo's surprise release was a cleaning game, the only kind of housework people preorder.

story.next: Watch for the Witchbrook launch on January 28 and more Switch 2 indie dates.
story.summary: Nintendo's 15-minute Indie World gave Witchbrook a January 28, 2027 date and released Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services the same day.
story.title: Nintendo's Indie World dates Witchbrook and shadow-drops a cleaning game
story.why: Several long-awaited indie games got dates, filling out the Switch 2 calendar for 2027.

story.background: No Man's Sky launched in 2016 to criticism and has since won players back with years of free updates.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It brings a huge console game to phones.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The game's comeback after a rough 2016 launch is well known.

story.happened: No Man's Sky launches on iPhone and iPad on October 28, Gaming Route reports. It is free to try and costs $19.99 to unlock, with a 3.8GB download. Multiplayer is not included at launch.

meme.bottom: Still smaller than your photo library
meme.take: No Man's Sky fits 18 quintillion planets into 3.8GB. Your group chat takes more.
meme.top: An infinite universe on your phone

story.next: Watch for performance tests on older iPhones and when multiplayer arrives.
story.summary: Hello Games' space survival game is free to try on iOS, with a $19.99 unlock and no multiplayer at launch.
story.title: No Man's Sky comes to iPhone and iPad on October 28
story.why: It is a full console game moving to phones, a test of how far mobile hardware has come.

story.background: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is often ranked among the greatest video games of all time.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The original came out on the Nintendo 64 in 1998.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A full-price tag for a classic invites debate about value.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Zelda remains one of Nintendo's best-selling series.

story.happened: Pre-orders are open, Gaming Route reports, with the game due on November 5 at $59.99 for the digital version and $69.99 for the physical edition.

meme.take: Ocarina of Time is back on Switch 2 for $69.99. The time travel works on the price too.

story.next: Watch for reviews and launch sales in early November.
story.summary: The Zelda classic for Switch 2 is priced at $59.99 digital and $69.99 physical, with release on November 5.
story.title: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 opens pre-orders ahead of November 5
story.why: Ocarina of Time is one of the most acclaimed games ever, and its return draws long-time Nintendo fans.

story.background: Jonathan Blow is an independent developer known for demanding puzzle games.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Jonathan Blow made Braid and The Witness.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Puzzle fans waited a decade for his next game.

story.happened: Order of the Sinking Star sold 45% more units on Steam in its first week than The Witness, with peak players 33% higher, Gaming Route reports. It launched October 8 at $30 and got a patch on October 17.

meme.bottom: Players are still stuck on level one
meme.take: Order of the Sinking Star outsold The Witness. Its buyers are now busy being stuck.

story.next: Watch for fixes to a reported level-reset bug.
story.summary: Jonathan Blow's new puzzle game sold 45% more Steam copies in week one than his 2016 hit, with a higher player peak.
story.title: Order of the Sinking Star outsells The Witness in its first week
story.why: Blow's games are cult favourites, and a strong start for a big puzzle game is rare.

story.background: Peak is a co-op game in which friends try to climb a mountain together.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Cheap co-op games played with friends have been some of the biggest indie hits.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Console players have waited for a version of their own.

story.happened: Peak, a co-op climbing game, launches on consoles this month, Game Informer reports. The console version includes all updates and content released to date.

meme.bottom: With friends who keep letting go
meme.take: Peak comes to consoles, giving more friendships a chance to fall off a cliff.
meme.top: A game about climbing a mountain

story.next: Watch for the exact console date and cross-play details.
story.summary: The co-op climbing game arrives on consoles with all the updates released on PC so far.
story.title: Indie hit Peak climbs onto consoles this month
story.why: Peak became a breakout PC hit, and console players have waited to join their friends.

story.background: PEGI is the age rating system used across most of Europe.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Critics have long compared loot boxes to gambling.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Both games are played by huge numbers of children and adults.

story.happened: PEGI has begun bumping games that contain loot boxes up to a 16 age rating, VGC reports. EA Sports FC and Pokemon Go are among the first big games affected.

meme.bottom: The Pokemon have not aged a day
meme.take: PEGI decided buying mystery boxes is adult behaviour, which explains a lot about adults.

story.next: Watch for which other big games are re-rated and how publishers respond.
story.summary: Ratings body PEGI has started raising games with loot boxes to a 16 rating, VGC reports.
story.title: EA Sports FC and Pokemon Go move to a 16 rating in Europe over loot boxes
story.why: Loot boxes have been criticised for years as too close to gambling for children.

story.background: Phantom Blade Zero is a martial arts action game. S-Game is a studio based in China.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: It drew more than 720,000 players at once on Steam.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Chinese studios are increasingly making big-budget console and PC games.

story.happened: The peak placed it 15th in Steam's overall rankings, Instant Gaming reports. Analysts had estimated sales near a million before launch. S-Game has not released sales figures.

meme.bottom: All of them learning to parry
meme.take: Phantom Blade Zero now has more players online than some games have ever had in total.

story.next: Watch for official sales figures from S-Game and the weekend player peak.
story.summary: S-Game's martial arts action game hit a Steam peak of 723,876 concurrent players after launching October 29 to an 88 Metacritic on PC.
story.title: Phantom Blade Zero passes 720,000 players at once on Steam
story.why: A hit this size confirms China's studios as a force in premium action games.

story.background: Pokémon began as a Nintendo Game Boy series in 1996 and its trading card game became a global craze.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It sold for nearly six times its pre-sale hopes.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Many of the cards date from the late-1990s Pokémon boom.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Trading card prices have risen sharply in recent years.

story.happened: The sale at Ewbank's on October 21 beat pre-sale hopes of around £270,000, Gaming Route reports. The top lot, a Legendary Collection master set, hammered at £100,000. The auction house calls it the UK's most valuable trading card sale.

meme.bottom: Turned out to be an investment plan
meme.take: A forgotten Pokémon collection made £1.56 million. Tidying up is now financially risky.

story.next: Watch for other old collections coming to auction on the back of this result.
story.summary: A collection stored in a Woking attic sold for £1.56 million at Ewbank's, far above its pre-sale hopes.
story.title: Pokémon cards left in an attic for 15 years sell for £1.56 million
story.why: It is the kind of find that sends people searching their lofts, and shows how valuable old cards have become.

story.background: The Pokemon Company manages the Pokemon brand, from games to trading cards and merchandise.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Pokemon fans outside Asia have had few official shops to visit.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is the first permanent store planned outside Asia.

story.happened: The Pokemon Company announced a permanent retail store in London, VGC reports. It is due to open by 2029 and is the first of several planned outside Asia.

meme.take: London gets a permanent Pokemon store by 2029. The queue may form a little earlier.
meme.top: A Pokemon store is coming to London

story.next: Watch for a location, an opening date and which cities come next.
story.summary: The Pokemon Company says it will open by 2029, the first of several permanent stores planned outside Asia.
story.title: A permanent Pokemon store is coming to London
story.why: Official Pokemon shops have mostly been in Japan and Asia, drawing fans from abroad.

story.background: Pokémon Unite is a five-on-five battle arena game that launched in 2021 on Switch and later on phones.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Pokémon is one of the best-known game franchises.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The final event lands four months before the servers close.

story.happened: A final event arrives November 12 with all Unite licences and Holoware released so far, Game Informer reports. A library feature will let players view records after shutdown but must be downloaded before March 23.

meme.take: Pokémon Unite is shutting down, and the gem shop was the first to leave the party.

story.next: Watch for the December 5 qualifiers for the Aeos Crown 2027 Tokyo tournament, which go ahead as planned.
story.summary: The free-to-play Pokémon battle arena game is ending service, and sales of gems and Unite Club memberships stopped on October 27.
story.title: Pokémon Unite will shut down on March 23, 2027
story.why: Pokémon is one of the biggest game franchises, and Unite was one of its main competitive games.

story.background: PlayStation Plus is Sony's subscription for online play and monthly games on PS4 and PS5.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Tomb Raider IV-VI are remasters of Lara Croft games from 1999 to 2003.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The games arrive at the start of the holiday season.

story.happened: The games can be claimed from November 3 until November 30. Tomb Raider and Dead Island 2 come to PS5 and PS4, while Monster Train 2 is on PS5.

meme.take: Sony's November lineup confirms Lara Croft is not allowed to retire.

story.next: Watch for the December line-up at the end of November.
story.summary: Sony's PlayStation Plus monthly games for November are Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered, Dead Island 2 and Monster Train 2, Kotaku reports.
story.title: PS Plus November brings Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered and Dead Island 2
story.why: The monthly picks are a key reason many PlayStation owners keep paying for the subscription.

story.background: The PlayStation 5 launched in 2020. GTA 6 is Rockstar Games' next Grand Theft Auto.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Consoles have become more expensive after 2026 price rises.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The cut lands before the holidays and GTA 6.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: GTA 6 is one of the most anticipated games ever.

story.happened: The refurbished Digital bundle with a DualSense dropped from $558 to $518, and the Disc bundle from $608 to $568, GamesRadar reports. A new PS5 now costs at least about $600 after Sony raised prices earlier in 2026.

meme.bottom: If you accept a previous owner
meme.take: Sony cut refurbished PS5 prices by $40. The new ones still cost about $600.

story.next: Watch for Black Friday deals on new PS5 consoles.
story.summary: PlayStation Direct in the US cut certified refurbished PS5 Digital and Disc bundles by $40 each.
story.title: Sony cuts $40 off refurbished PS5 bundles ahead of GTA 6
story.why: After price rises earlier this year, cheaper consoles matter to players planning to buy for GTA 6.

story.background: The PlayStation 5 launched in 2020 and now costs over 50% more than at launch, VGC notes.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Memory costs alone would exceed a typical console price.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI data center demand has made memory chips scarce.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players are watching closely for next-gen news.

story.happened: Leaker Kepler_L2 said in a forum post that PS6 memory and storage costs exceed $680, but should fall once the design is final, VGC reports. Analysts quoted expect next-gen consoles near or above $1,000. Sony has not announced pricing.

meme.bottom: The console is still a rumour
meme.take: The next PlayStation already has a price problem and has not yet been announced.
meme.top: The PS6 memory is said to cost $680

story.next: Watch for Sony's own comments on PS6 timing and price.
story.summary: An insider says RAM and storage costs could push the next PlayStation past $1,000, as AI data centers drive memory prices up.
story.title: PlayStation 6 memory alone is claimed to cost over $680 per console
story.why: A $1,000 console would be a big shift for players used to $500 launch prices.

story.background: Rockstar Games, owned by Take-Two, makes Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Rockstar's headcount almost doubled during development.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Two delays pushed the game from 2025 to November 2026.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The game is believed to have the largest budget of any game.

story.happened: Bloomberg reports Rockstar grew from 2,441 staff at Red Dead Redemption 2's launch to 4,711 in August 2026, partly to cut crunch. Head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe denied the budget beat a reported $1.5 billion, and said workers will get a union if they want one.

meme.bottom: Next time will be quicker, apparently
meme.take: Rockstar promises its next game will come faster. In Rockstar time, that is still a while.

story.next: Watch for a confirmed PC date, which GamesBeat reports is in Q1 2027.
story.summary: Rockstar's staff nearly doubled since 2018, and executives say future games will come faster on the tools built for GTA VI.
story.title: Bloomberg report details why GTA VI took almost eight years
story.why: It is a rare inside look at the making of one of the most expensive games ever.

story.background: Rockstar Games, owned by Take-Two, makes Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: GTA 6 launches November 19 and is one of the most awaited games ever.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: The union says Rockstar's 2025 firings were union busting.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The comments come five weeks before launch.

story.happened: Rockstar's head of publishing told Bloomberg that if staff want a union, they will have one, This Week in Videogames reports. Weekly talks with the Rockstar Games Workers Union are described as positive. Development leads said tools built for GTA 6 will make future games faster.

meme.bottom: Rockstar promises the next one won't
meme.take: Rockstar says its next game will come faster, so fans have pencilled in the 2030s.

story.next: Watch for the delayed verdict in the Glasgow dismissal case, now due in mid-November.
story.summary: In a Bloomberg feature on GTA 6, Rockstar leaders spoke about union talks and a faster pace for future games.
story.title: Rockstar says staff can have a union, and its next game won't take eight years
story.why: GTA 6 is the year's biggest launch, and Rockstar rarely talks publicly about how it works.

story.background: BioWare made Mass Effect and Dragon Age. Electronic Arts bought the studio in 2007.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Over 219,000 signatures in about a week.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The original trilogy is regarded as a landmark of story-driven games.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Both actors who voiced Commander Shepard back the campaign.

story.happened: The petition passed 219,000 signatures on October 26. A creator paid about $250 for a 15-second Times Square spot, Kotaku reports. Composer Austin Wintory shared drafts meant for Mass Effect 5, and Canada's NDP leader backed a staff buyout.

meme.take: Mass Effect fans bought a Times Square ad for $250. Marketing departments, take notes.

story.next: Watch for any response from EA about the Mass Effect rights.
story.summary: The fan petition kept growing after BioWare's closure, with a Times Square ad and early Mass Effect 5 music drafts shared.
story.title: Save Mass Effect petition passes 219,000 signatures and reaches Times Square
story.why: It is one of the largest fan campaigns in recent gaming, aimed at one of the medium's best-loved series.

story.background: Aspyr is a studio known for porting and remastering older games.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The original game came out in 2004 alongside the hit film.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Its GTA-style trailer lands weeks before GTA VI.

story.happened: Aspyr's remaster of the 2004 Shrek 2 game was revealed with a GTA-style trailer, VGC reports. Its November release on Xbox Series X|S was confirmed at the ID@Xbox Showcase, Pure Xbox reports.

meme.take: Shrek 2 got a GTA-style trailer, the only way to launch anything this autumn.

story.next: Watch for an exact release day and other platforms.
story.summary: Aspyr's remaster was revealed with a trailer styled after GTA, and its November date was confirmed for Xbox.
story.title: A remaster of the 2004 Shrek 2 game is coming in November
story.why: The licensed game is fondly remembered by people who played it as kids.

story.background: Companies file many patents that never become products, so a patent is not a product plan.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI-made frames are already common on PC graphics cards.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Sony makes the PlayStation.

story.happened: US patent application 2026/0320740, published October 15, describes using AI to predict the next frame of a game before it is rendered, Patentlyze reports. The filing does not mention the PS6.

meme.bottom: Before the game has drawn it
meme.take: Sony patents an AI that sees the future, though only as far as the next frame.
meme.top: Sony's AI guesses the next frame

story.next: Watch for whether Sony mentions similar tech for future PlayStation hardware.
story.summary: A newly published Sony patent covers predicting upcoming frames without waiting for the real ones to render.
story.title: Sony patent describes AI that predicts game frames to cut lag
story.why: Lower lag matters for cloud and competitive play, and any Sony hardware hint draws attention.

story.background: Valve runs the Steam store and makes hardware such as the Steam Deck and the Index VR headset.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A price above $1,000 puts it in premium headset territory.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Valve's Steam platform dominates PC gaming.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players have waited years for new Valve VR hardware.

story.happened: Gaming Route reports the Steam Frame is priced at $1,059 for 256GB and $1,299 for 1TB. People who reserved one can place orders by December or in 2027, depending on their place in the queue.

meme.bottom: The 1TB one is for the brave
meme.take: Valve priced the Steam Frame at $1,059, a number PC players will now call reasonable.

story.next: Watch for review units and how quickly the reservation queue moves.
story.summary: Valve's Steam Frame costs $1,059 with 256GB or $1,299 with 1TB, with reservation holders able to order by December or in 2027.
story.title: Valve prices the Steam Frame headset from $1,059
story.why: Valve's hardware sets the tone for PC VR, and the price is higher than many fans hoped.

story.background: Steam is Valve's PC games store and launcher, the largest digital storefront for PC games.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Steam has tens of millions of daily users.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It hit during a week of big game launches.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Status pages showed green while users were locked out.

story.happened: Downdetector reports began around 10:00 UTC on October 26, PC Gamer says. SteamDB showed all services as green, and Valve had not commented at the time of reporting.

meme.take: Steam was up, technically. Some users just could not get in, which is also technically up.
meme.top: Steam's status page said all green

story.next: Watch for a fix or explanation from Valve.
story.summary: PC Gamer reports some players could not get past Steam's "Loading user data" screen on Monday.
story.title: Some Steam users get stuck on a loading screen as login problems spread
story.why: Steam is the main PC games store, so even partial outages leave many players unable to play.

story.background: Valve runs Steam Next Fest three times a year to showcase upcoming games.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Hundreds of games usually take part.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: All demos are free with a Steam account.

story.happened: PC Gamer counts 8,011 demos on the press preview page, about double the June 2026 fest. On its first day, ArcheAge Chronicles led with about 18,000 live players, ahead of Loftia, Output Lag's tracker showed. The fest runs to October 26.

meme.take: Steam Next Fest now has more demos than most people have free evenings this decade.
